'''Tremorfoot''' was a particularly strong and tough [[Tulrus/Legends|tulrus]] that lived on the [[Tulrus Nesting Grounds]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
